retrieved_evidence.text: The laboratory shall keep record of the communication with the patient.
Critical laboratory results shall be reported clearly to the patient.
The laboratory should direct the patient to seek further medical advice.
The laboratory shall have a policy for identifying and reporting critical results.

Accurate: Data must be accurate and truthful at aggregate and record level, representing what was intended /defined by their official source. Data recorded in Data Subject/Patient EMRs must accurately reflect each other and the care/treatment provided to the Data Subject/Patient.

criteria.SEND_PRIMARY: Send the result notification on the approved primary channel.
criteria.AWAIT_EVIDENCE: Wait: a receipt or other required evidence has not arrived yet.
criteria.RECONCILE_ATTEMPT: Ask the provider what happened to an attempt whose outcome is unknown before doing anything else.
criteria.RETRY_SAME_CHANNEL: Retry on the same channel (only after the earlier attempt is reconciled).
criteria.PROPOSE_FALLBACK: Propose an alternative channel, which needs an approved fallback procedure.
criteria.AWAIT_ACKNOWLEDGMENT: Delivery is evidenced; wait for the patient's acknowledgment of the current result version.
criteria.RECORD_DOCUMENTATION: The communication is evidenced end to end; record it as required.
criteria.OPEN_CORRECTION_TASK: The result was corrected; cancel stale messages and open a reviewed correction task.
criteria.ESCALATE_HUMAN: Identity, scope, wording or next step is uncertain; hand to the named supervisor.
criteria.VERIFY_RECIPIENT: The recipient or contact is not verified; verify before sending.
criteria.NO_ACTION: Nothing should be done at this step.

alternative.instructions: If the action under review were not taken, which action would the evidence support instead?
